maria (BetaShop): Hi team, our QA flagged the rerank results after using the Console 'Try it' snippet. We pasted the cURL, changed the query, and got two problems: an immediate 400 complaining about "unknown field 'items'" and elsewhere the scores were weird (some >1, one -inf). Sharing what we ran.

Evan (Support): Thanks Maria. Can you paste the exact cURL and one of the offending responses? Also which region/host were you hitting?

maria (BetaShop): Using the Console snippet (copied straight):

```bash
curl 'https://api.redwood.ai/v1/reranker' \ 
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer sk-REDACTED' \ 
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \ 
  -d '{"query":"top budget phones","items":["Pixel 6","iPhone SE","Moto G"]}'
```

Response 1:
```json
{"error":"Unknown field 'items'"}
```

maria (BetaShop): Then we tried a different path someone sent (v1/rerankings) and got a 200 but with strange numbers: one score was 2.7 and one entry was "-inf".

Tina (SRE): Two separate issues likely: Console generator is outputting an older/alternate path (/v1/reranker) and a payload using 'items' which doesn't match the current API schema ('candidates' or 'documents' depending on model). Also scoring mode defaults changed during last rollout; raw logits can exceed 1 and -inf can appear when the model scores encounter numerical instability for empty/malformed candidates.

maria (BetaShop): Example of the 200 body we got (redacted):
```json
{"id":"r_2026_01","results":[{"candidate":"Pixel 6","score":2.7},{"candidate":"iPhone SE","score":-0.002},{"candidate":"Moto G","score":"-inf"}]}
```

Evan (Support): Can you confirm candidate strings are exactly as shown and not containing newlines or control chars? Also which client OS / shell? Single quotes in the Console snippet can be problematic on Windows cmd/powershell.

maria (BetaShop): We ran it from Mac terminal. Strings are plain. We also tried a file payload which fixed the -inf for that candidate once we trimmed whitespace, but scores still above 1.

Liam (Docs): quick note: our public docs show both /v1/reranker and /v1/rerankings in different pages due to a merge conflict that wasn't resolved cleanly. Console uses the legacy snippet for backward compatibility in some regions which is why users copy a bad path. Also historically we had an 'items' field name; schema normalized to 'candidates' last quarter, but example generators didn't get updated everywhere. We'll fix.

Tina (SRE): About the numbers: default score_mode is currently "raw" for historical reasons. Raw logits are unbounded. If you want normalized probabilities use "score_mode":"softmax" or normalized 0-1 with "score_mode":"minmax". The -inf indicates an underflow/overflow from an internal exponential during softmax computation if you previously requested it or if a candidate tokenization produced an empty vector—so it can show up transiently. We added server-side protections but some edge cases still bubble up as strings like "-inf" in JSON. We'll tighten that.

Evan (Support): For immediate repro guidance to customers we recommend: 1) Use the canonical path /v1/rerankings, 2) Send JSON with "candidates" as the array key, 3) Validate payload with jq, and 4) include "score_mode":"minmax" if you need 0-1 scores. Example safe workflow: create payload.json and use --data-binary.

maria (BetaShop): Could you paste the exact safe example? That would help our devs.

Evan (Support): Sure — create payload.json locally: 
```json
{
  "queries": [{"query": "top budget phones"}],
  "candidates": ["Pixel 6", "iPhone SE", "Moto G"],
  "max_candidates": 32,
  "score_mode": "minmax"
}
```
Send with:
```bash
jq . payload.json > payload_valid.json
curl -sS -X POST "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/rerankings" \ 
  -H "Authorization: Bearer sk-REDACTED" \ 
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \ 
  --data-binary @payload_valid.json
```
Notes: --data-binary preserves exact bytes; avoid copying single-quoted JSON from Console into Windows cmd. PowerShell multiline string alternative: use @' ... '@ wrapper. Also don't exceed 64 candidates per query (current cluster limit) and keep payload < 256KB.

rerank-bot: [service] 2026-03-15T13:02:11Z INFO reranker: returning raw logits for request r_2026_01 (score_mode=raw)

maria (BetaShop): Using that payload flow we get normalized scores now, and no -inf. Thanks! We'll update our internal runbooks.

Liam (Docs): Action items: 1) Fix inconsistent path examples (Console + docs) to always show /v1/rerankings. 2) Replace old 'items' example with 'candidates' and show both single-query array and multi-query examples. 3) Document default score_mode and show examples for raw/minmax/softmax with expected ranges. 4) Add a Windows PowerShell example and a note about single vs double quotes. I'll open a docs PR and coordinate with Console engineers.

Tina (SRE): I'll add a server-side lint to convert explicit numeric -inf/NaN to null and include a warning in the response metadata so clients don't misinterpret strings as valid numbers.

Evan (Support): Marking this thread for followup once docs/console changes merge. Maria, please re-open if anything else pops up. :raised_hands:

maria (BetaShop): Will do — appreciate the quick help!
